purpose: Promise helpers for Roblox sounds and video frames.
description: Promise helpers for Roblox sounds and video frames.

SoundPromiseUtils.luau.description: Promise helpers for Roblox sounds and video frames. Public entry points include `SoundPromiseUtils.promiseLoaded`, `SoundPromiseUtils.promisePlayed`, `SoundPromiseUtils.promiseLooped`, `SoundPromiseUtils.promiseAllSoundsLoaded`.

SoundUtils.luau.description: Helps plays back sounds in the Roblox engine. Public entry points include `SoundUtils.promiseLoaded`, `SoundUtils.playFromId`, `SoundUtils.cloneMerge`, `SoundUtils.createSoundFromId`, `SoundUtils.applyPropertiesFromId`, `SoundUtils.playFromIdInParent`, `SoundUtils.playFromIdInParentWithProperties`, `SoundUtils.playAtCFrame`.
